about.title: Built by Turfers, for Turfers
about.description1: TurfGPS started as a hobby project to solve common challenges faced by Turfgame players. As avid turfers ourselves, we wanted to create tools that would enhance the game experience.
about.description2: Our mission is to provide completely free, high-quality tools that help the Turf community plan better routes, discover new zones, and enjoy the game even more.

questions.question: Is TurfGPS affiliated with the official Turfgame?
questions.answer: No, TurfGPS is an independent, fan-made project created to enhance the Turfgame experience. We are not officially affiliated with or endorsed by Turfgame.

questions.question: Do I need to create an account to use TurfGPS?
questions.answer: No, all of our tools are available without requiring an account or login. Just visit the site and start planning your routes!

questions.question: How accurate is the route planning?
questions.answer: Our route planning algorithm calculates efficient paths between zones based on distance and other factors. While we strive for accuracy, the actual optimal route may vary depending on real-world conditions like traffic, terrain, and accessibility.

questions.question: Can I contribute to the project?
questions.answer: TurfGPS is an open-source project, feel free to contribute. Check out our GitHub repository to get started with contributions, report bugs, or suggest new features.

questions.question: How do I report bugs or suggest features?
questions.answer: You can report bugs or suggest features by opening an issue on our GitHub repository or by contacting us directly through the provided contact information.
